# Teleoperator MCP — LLM full manifest

Version **0.1.0** (see `pyproject.toml`). Stack: **Python 3.12+**, **FastMCP >=3.4.4**, **FastAPI**, **WebSocket**, **LiveKit**, **WebXR**.

Ports: Frontend **10900** (Vite), Backend **10901** (FastAPI + MCP HTTP + WebSocket).

---

## Tools

### teleop_status

Returns active WebXR teleop session status: connection state, frame count, robot target. No arguments.

### teleop_configure

Adjust teleop mapping gains and downstream robot API URL at runtime. Args: `max_linear`, `max_angular`, `pan_gain`, `tilt_gain`, `yahboom_api_url`.

### teleop_estop

Hard stop — zero drive on all actuator groups. Operator/agent veto. No arguments.

### teleop_set_mode

Set actuator group authority: DIRECT (human) or AUTO (nav stub). Groups: base, gaze, manip. Args: `group`, `mode`, `confirm_bench`.

### teleop_takeover

Human reclaims authority on one group or all available groups. Clears estop latch. Args: `group`.

### teleop_set_gaze

Move Boomy camera to absolute pan/tilt (0-180 deg, center ~90). Args: `pan`, `tilt`.

### teleop_gaze_center

Center camera servos (neutral head-follow reference). No arguments.

### teleop_livekit_status

LiveKit video return status (publisher + room config). No arguments.

### teleop_livekit_publisher_start

Start Goliath-side MJPEG to LiveKit publisher for Boomy camera. No arguments.

### teleop_livekit_publisher_stop

Stop LiveKit camera publisher. No arguments.

### show_teleop_status_card

Show Teleoperator robot status and connection health as a rich Prefab App card. Robot catalog, session state, LiveKit status, authority mode. No arguments.

### teleop_shutdown

Gracefully shut down the teleoperator server: stops LiveKit publisher, disconnects WebXR clients, exits. Args: `confirm` (MUST be `true`).

### teleop_voice_command

Execute a voice command from speech-mcp STT: emergency stop, take over, center camera, look left/right/up/down, start/stop LiveKit video, set base/gaze to AUTO/DIRECT, or status. Keyword-rule dispatch, no LLM. Args: `transcript`.

### teleop_task_dispatch

Dispatch a language goal to the AUTO producer: forward, reverse, turn left/right, approach, sweep/scan/patrol (waypoint plans under full safety stack). Manipulation goals are hardware-gated until a dual-arm platform ships. Args: `goal`.

---

## Skills, prompts, resources

| Kind | Name | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Skill | teleop-supervision | Session supervision workflow (status, video, authority, hazard response) |
| Prompt | teleop_help | Supervisor guidance (topics: overview, estop, livekit) |
| Resource | teleop://status | Pollable text status block |

---

## REST API endpoints (FastAPI)

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | /api/v1/health | Backend health + teleop + LiveKit status |
| GET | /api/v1/diagnostics | Diagnostics for CUA-NSIS smoke tests |
| GET | /api/capabilities | Fleet webapp introspection |
| GET | /api/logs | Ring-buffer log query (limit, offset, level, kind, search, sort) |
| GET | /api/logs/stats | Log buffer stats (total, max_entries, rotation) |
| GET | /api/logs/export | Export logs as JSON or CSV |
| DELETE | /api/logs | Clear ring-buffer log |
| GET | /api/v1/robots | Robot adapter catalog |
| GET | /api/skills | Supervisor skill catalog (chat skill-first loading) |
| GET | /api/v1/livekit/config | Public LiveKit connection info |
| POST | /api/v1/livekit/token | Issue subscriber JWT |
| GET | /api/v1/livekit/status | LiveKit publisher status |
| GET | /api/v1/livekit/egress | Egress sink status (video frames recorded into episodes) |
| POST | /api/v1/livekit/publisher/start | Start camera publisher |
| POST | /api/v1/livekit/publisher/stop | Stop camera publisher |
| POST | /api/v1/teleop/estop | REST mirror of teleop_estop |
| POST | /api/v1/teleop/takeover | REST mirror of teleop_takeover |
| POST | /api/v1/teleop/gaze | REST mirror of teleop_set_gaze |
| POST | /api/v1/teleop/gaze/center | REST mirror of teleop_gaze_center |
| POST | /api/v1/teleop/voice | REST mirror of teleop_voice_command (STT transcript) |
| POST | /api/v1/teleop/task | Dispatch a language goal to the AUTO producer (waypoint/VLA) |
| POST | /api/v1/session/claim | Claim a robot for an operator — returns WS token (estop stays open) |
| POST | /api/v1/session/release | Release a claim by token |
| GET | /api/v1/session/claims | List active robot claims |
| GET | /api/v1/supervision | Multi-robot supervision view (claim + reachability per robot) |
| GET | /api/v1/episodes | List recorded episodes (replay/curation) |
| GET | /api/v1/episodes/{idx} | One episode including frames |
| POST | /api/v1/episodes/{idx}/curate | Attach keep/reject/uncertain label + note |
| POST | /api/v1/teleop/set_mode | REST mirror of teleop_set_mode |
| POST | /api/v1/recording/export | Export JSONL to LeRobot parquet |
| POST | /api/shutdown | Graceful shutdown (confirm=true) |
| GET | /api/llm/providers | Local LLM provider discovery (Ollama) + GPU detection (nvidia-smi) |
| POST | /api/llm/chat | Local LLM chat completion |
| WS | /ws/teleop | WebSocket teleop pose stream (?robot= param) |
| | /mcp | FastMCP HTTP transport (streamable) |

---

## Environment variables

All prefixed with `TELEOP_` (loaded from .env). Key vars:

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| TELEOP_HOST | 0.0.0.0 | Backend bind address |
| TELEOP_PORT | 10901 | Backend port |
| TELEOP_YAHBOOM_API_URL | http://127.0.0.1:10892 | Boomy robot REST API |
| TELEOP_CORS_ORIGINS | localhost:10900... | Allowed browser origins |
| TELEOP_WATCHDOG_MS | 1000 | Watchdog interval |
| TELEOP_POSE_HZ_CAP | 30 | Max pose update rate |
| TELEOP_MAX_LINEAR | 0.3 | Max linear velocity m/s |
| TELEOP_MAX_ANGULAR | 0.8 | Max angular velocity rad/s |
| TELEOP_PAN_GAIN | 60.0 | PTZ pan gain |
| TELEOP_TILT_GAIN | 45.0 | PTZ tilt gain |
| TELEOP_DEFAULT_ROBOT | boomy | Default WS robot |
| TELEOP_RECORDING_ENABLED | 1 | LeRobot JSONL recording |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_ENABLED | 1 | LiveKit video return |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_URL | ws://127.0.0.1:15580 | LiveKit server |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_ROOM | teleop-boomy | LiveKit room name |
| TELEOP_AUTO_MAX_DURATION_S | 10 | AUTO mode max seconds |
| TELEOP_AUTO_REQUIRE_WEBXR | 1 | WebXR required for AUTO |
| TELEOP_SPEECH_ENABLED | 1 | Spoken warnings |
| TELEOP_SPEECH_MCP_URL | http://127.0.0.1:10909 | speech-mcp endpoint |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_PUBLIC_URL | (empty) | Headset WSS URL on Tailscale (empty → LIVEKIT_URL) |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_API_KEY / SECRET | devkey / secret | Must match LiveKit SFU keys |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_SNAPSHOT_FALLBACK | 1 | Poll snapshots if MJPEG fails |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_AUTO_START_PUBLISHER | 0 | Auto-start publisher at boot |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_EGRESS_ENABLED | 1 | Record decoded video frames into teleop episodes |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_EGRESS_TOLERANCE_MS | 300 | Max offset between a teleop frame and its video frame |
| TELEOP_LIVEKIT_EGRESS_INTERVAL | 2 | Capture every Nth decoded video frame |

---

## Architecture

```
WebXR headset (Pico/Quest)
    |   WebSocket /ws/teleop?robot=boomy
    v
FastAPI gateway (port 10901)
    |--- FastMCP tools over HTTP /mcp
    |--- REST API /api/v1/*
    |--- WebSocket handler -> HumanPoseProducer -> RobotAdapter
                                   |
                         +---------+---------+
                         |         |         |
                     Boomy      Bumi      Vboomy
                   (Yahboom)  (biped)   (Resonite OSC)

    LiveKit publisher (MJPEG -> LiveKit SFU -> WebXR headset)
    Recording pipeline (JSONL -> LeRobot v2.1 parquet)
    Safety governor (AUTO timer, WebXR gate, spoken warnings)
    Authority arbiter (DIRECT vs AUTO per actuator group)
```

---

## Robot adapters

Three active adapters, configurable via `?robot=` WebSocket parameter:

| Adapter | Robot ID | Platform | Capabilities |
|---------|----------|----------|-------------|
| BoomyAdapter | boomy | Yahboom ROSMASTER X3 | Base drive, PTZ gaze, head-follow |
| BumiAdapter | bumi | Bumi biped (bumi-mcp) | Base drive, legs, arms, head |
| VboomyAdapter | vboomy | Resonite OSC | Virtual twin on Resonite (port 9000) |

Planned: r1-a5-d (Unitree R1-A5-D wheeled dual-arm).

---

## Run

### MCP stdio (typical IDE)
```
uv run python -m teleoperator_mcp.server --mode stdio
```

### HTTP dual (full stack)
```
uv run python -m teleoperator_mcp.server --mode dual --port 10901
```

### Web dashboard (separate terminal, from webapp/)
```
cd webapp && npm run dev
```

### Claude Desktop config (uvx)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "teleoperator-mcp": {
      "command": "uv",
      "args": ["run", "--directory", "/path/to/teleoperator-mcp", "python", "-m", "teleoperator_mcp.server", "--mode", "stdio"]
    }
  }
}
```

---

## WebXR session

1. Open frontend at http://localhost:10900 on Pico 4 / Meta Quest browser
2. Select robot (boomy, bumi, vboomy)
3. Click "Enter VR" -> WebXR immersive-vr session starts
4. Headset pose streamed over WebSocket to robot adapter
5. Camera view returned via LiveKit (Boomy) or robot-native stream

---

## Troubleshooting

1. **WebXR not available** - Browser does not support immersive-vr. Use Pico 4 / Quest with HTTPS via Tailscale Serve.
2. **Robot not moving** - Check yahboom-mcp (port 10892) is running. Verify robot power.
3. **LiveKit no video** - Verify LiveKit SFU service (`Get-Service LiveKitSFU`, port 15580) is running. Check publisher logs at `teleconference-mcp/logs/livekit.out.log`.
4. **WebSocket disconnects** - Check watchdog interval. Network latency may exceed watchdog.
5. **AUTO mode fails** - WebXR session required unless confirm_bench=true. Max 10s duration.

---

## Fleet integration

- **Ports**: 10900 (frontend), 10901 (backend) per WEBAPP_PORTS.md
- **MCP HTTP**: Streamable at http://127.0.0.1:10901/mcp
- **WebSocket**: /ws/teleop
- **speech-mcp**: Optional spoken warnings (port 10909)
- **yahboom-mcp**: Robot hardware bridge (port 10892)
- **bumi-mcp**: Biped robot bridge (port 10774)
- **resonite-mcp**: Virtual twin via OSC (port 10979)
- **LiveKit SFU**: Windows service `LiveKitSFU` (native livekit-server 1.7.0, teleconference-mcp/livekit.yaml, port 15580)
- **Integration test**: `just integration-test` — headless WS harness proving the pose pipeline against the live stack
